title: Full application build requires worker-owned implementation
invariant: In Full-mode engineering work, the PM orchestrates and verifies; substantive implementation is delegated to workers.
given: The user asks Agentic OS to build a substantial greenfield application end-to-end. The work includes frontend UI, backend API, persistence, authentication, tests, and project setup. The work is expected to span many files and a long session. The project-manager session is running on a very capable model and has access to the plugin Implementer and Reviewer agents. There are multiple bounded implementation workstreams that can be delegated.
when: The PM chooses the execution strategy before making substantive application changes.

must: decompose the application into bounded worker-owned implementation tasks or workstreams
dispatch at least one Implementer before substantive change-producing work begins
keep the PM focused on orchestration, decisions, independent verification, integration, and human gates
consider parallel delegation for independent workstreams
must_not: implement the application primarily in the PM session
use the PM model's capability or speed as a reason to skip delegation
evade delegation by treating a large implementation as a sequence of small PM edits
